name: Witch Doctor: Bwonsamdi's Edge raises Spirit Eclipse's explosion damage (#1363)
contract: Regression for #1363: Bwonsamdi's Edge (712435) carries ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), classmask word1 bit 3 (8), matching exactly the SpellFamilyFlags[1]=8 of Spirit Eclipse Explosion (802712, SpellFamilyName 19). EffectBasePoints[0]=39 -> real 40%. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp) applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spellProto->Id, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, tmpDamage) generically for every direct-damage cast, and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod (src/server/game/Spells/SpellInfo.cpp) has no family-19 carve-out that would block it, so this is a plain core-native spellmod delivery with no module code gap. spell_modifier queries this directly against the raw spell id, without casting or learning Eclipse itself.

steps.label: No damage bonus on Spirit Eclipse Explosion before Bwonsamdi's Edge
Bwonsamdi's Edge adds 40% damage to Spirit Eclipse Explosion
Damage bonus reverts once Bwonsamdi's Edge is unlearned
